(a) only a minority of women with locally advanced cervical carcinoma in Virginia received all components of indicated therapy, (b) receipt of quality care was associated with younger age, higher stage of disease, and treatment at a higher volume facility, (c) receipt of quality cancer therapy was strongly associated with survival.
